findings.claim: Two cron entries on the same path will race for the same queued jobs because the claim is not atomic; each invocation's select can return the same rows.
findings.evidence: each invocation takes its own 50 queued jobs

findings.claim: An unauthenticated cron endpoint is reachable by anyone; 'not guessable' is not an auth control.
findings.evidence: the path is not guessable in practice

findings.claim: Transient failures like storage timeouts mark the job failed forever with no retry or backoff, even though attempts and run_at were added for exactly that.
findings.recommendation: Retry with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts, then dead-letter.

findings.claim: Loading a 25 MB JPEG into memory and producing three derivatives with sharp will exceed the memory available to the serverless function.
findings.evidence: sharp resizes a 20 MB JPEG in ~2s
findings.recommendation: Stream and process one derivative at a time.
